title: Lawyers debate before NY judge whether Micron environmental report was good enough
summary: A New York court hearing examined whether Micron Technology's 20,000-page environmental report for its chipmaking project near Syracuse met regulatory standards. The proceeding involved legal arguments about environmental assessment adequacy, relevant to Syracuse's economic development and state-level permitting processes.
